sourcedFrom: Ruger LCP MAX Instruction Manual — LCP MAX 4/2026 R6 (2026)
cleanIntro: The LCP MAX has a pried takedown pin rather than a lever, and that is the one step that surprises people. Ruger publishes separate books for the LCP MAX with a manual safety and for the version with a loaded chamber indicator and magazine disconnect; this guide follows the plain LCP MAX manual.

steps.title: Magazine out
steps.action: Keep the pistol pointed in a safe direction, press the magazine latch and withdraw the magazine from the butt of the pistol.
steps.prose: Magazine first, every time — the chamber check that follows means nothing before it.
steps.quote:
Keep pistol pointed in a 
safe direction. Press the 
magazine latch and 
withdraw the magazine 
from butt of pistol (see 
Figure 15).
steps.cite: Ruger LCP MAX Instruction Manual — LCP MAX 4/2026 R6 — Disassembly, step 1, p.28
steps.warn: Always unload a firearm before cleaning, lubrication, disassembly, or assembly.

steps.title: Lock the slide open and inspect the chamber
steps.action: Pull the slide to the rear and lock it in the open position by pushing upward on the slide stop, then look into the chamber and verify it is empty.
steps.prose: Keep your hand away from the muzzle while the slide is being worked — Ruger prints that instruction beside the figure.
steps.quote:
Pull slide to the rear and 
lock in the open position 
by pushing upward on the 
slide stop. (See Figure 16).
steps.cite: Ruger LCP MAX Instruction Manual — LCP MAX 4/2026 R6 — Disassembly, step 2, p.28

steps.title: Release the slide stop and let the slide run forward
steps.action: Retract the slide slightly and release it. That disengages the slide stop and lets the slide travel fully forward.
steps.prose: The takedown pin will not come out with the slide locked back. This is the step that makes room for it.
steps.quote:
disengage the slide stop 
and allow the slide to 
move fully forward.
steps.cite: Ruger LCP MAX Instruction Manual — LCP MAX 4/2026 R6 — Disassembly, step 4, p.29

steps.title: Pry the takedown pin loose, then out
steps.action: Work a screwdriver or another flat, blunt tool under the takedown pin and pry it loose, then draw the pin out completely.
steps.prose: This pin is pried, not pushed. Use something flat and blunt — a sharp blade marks the frame and does not lift the pin any better.
steps.quote:
Pry loose the takedown 
pin using a screwdriver 
or other flat, blunt tool 
(see Figure 19).
steps.cite: Ruger LCP MAX Instruction Manual — LCP MAX 4/2026 R6 — Disassembly, steps 5 and 6, p.29

steps.title: Slide assembly forward off the frame
steps.action: Move the slide assembly forward and separate it from the grip frame.
steps.prose: With the pin out there is nothing holding it. It should come away without force.
steps.quote:
Move the slide 
assembly 
forward and 
separate it 
from the grip 
frame (see 
Figure 21).
steps.cite: Ruger LCP MAX Instruction Manual — LCP MAX 4/2026 R6 — Disassembly, step 7, p.29

steps.title: Recoil spring assembly off the barrel lug
steps.action: Compress the recoil spring assembly slightly to disengage it from its seat against the barrel lug, then lift it out.
steps.prose: Compress, unseat, lift — and keep it controlled. It is a captive assembly but it is still a loaded spring.
steps.quote:
Compress the recoil 
spring assembly 
slightly to disengage it 
from its seat against 
the barrel lug, and 
remove it completely 
(see Figure 22).
steps.cite: Ruger LCP MAX Instruction Manual — LCP MAX 4/2026 R6 — Disassembly, step 8, p.30

steps.title: Barrel forward, down, and back out
steps.action: Move the barrel forward slightly, then down and back to extract it from the slide. The pistol is now stripped for cleaning.
steps.prose: Three small movements, not one pull. Trying to lift the barrel straight out jams it against the slide.
steps.quote:
Remove the barrel. It will 
be necessary to move the 
barrel forward slightly and 
then down and back to 
extract it from the slide 
(see Figure 23).
steps.cite: Ruger LCP MAX Instruction Manual — LCP MAX 4/2026 R6 — Disassembly, step 9, p.30

deepAbsentReason: The LCP MAX manual closes its disassembly with "NOTE: Do not attempt further disassembly of your firearm. The firearm can now be cleaned and lubricated. There are no user serviceable parts below this level." (p.30). Nothing past the strip is published, so this listing has NO deep clean.

cleaning.name: BORE & CHAMBER
tasks: Solvent-wet patch through the bore, then a solvent-wet bristle brush the full length, then dry patches and examine
Grease left in the chamber interferes with feeding from the magazine

cleaning.name: SLIDE & FRAME
tasks: Solvent on a patch or brush to take powder residue off every component, then a dry patch through the bore and a very lightly oiled one after it
Only a light application of oil — excess oil attracts dust and can congeal in cold weather

cleaning.name: MAGAZINES
tasks: Check the follower moves freely and the lips are free of nicks, burrs, cracks or deformation
Magazines go back dry — no oil where ammunition sits

cleaning.name: INSPECT
tasks: Look over the pistol and magazine for anything damaged, missing, loose, bent, cracked, chipped or peened
Never use automotive or paint-stripping products on a firearm

reassembly: With the slide held upside down, replace the barrel and push it rearward into its locked position.
Place the guide rod / recoil spring assembly back with its rear end seated against the barrel lug.
Fit the slide assembly to the frame and press the takedown pin fully home before handling further.
fncheck: With the magazine out and the chamber confirmed empty, check the slide runs fully and locks back on an empty magazine, and that the trigger resets — pointed in a safe direction throughout.
